content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know how to connect to a [product_name] [version_no] using the Ethernet port? My laptop doesn't have a built-in Ethernet port. Is using a USB to RJ45 adapter an option? Thanks, [user_name]

There isn't a [product_name] 24RCo for the [product_name] [version_no] series. Perhaps you meant the 24RC E o. You could try using an adapter such as a USB 3.0 to Gigabit Ethernet NIC Network Adapter.
